Job Title: Graphic Designer
Company Name: Fete Chinoise (PALETTERA Inc.)
Location: Markham, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-07-24
Job Type: full
Remote: yes
Salary: $22
Job URL: http://ca.indeed.com/job/graphic-designer-0088c779281c0ef6
Source: indeed
Job Description: **About us**  
PALETTERA is a leading creative agency specializing in **event branding and design, high\-end publications \& editorial design, experiential activations, and business branding**. We bring bold ideas to life through thoughtful design, immersive experiences, and high\-quality execution. Our team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and pushing visual boundaries.

We are currently seeking a talented and passionate **Graphic Designer** to join our dynamic team. If you are a creative professional with strong technical skills and an eye for detail, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create visually compelling graphics and creative work using **Adobe Creative Suite** (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, etc.)
* Develop and execute layouts for **magazines, books, and editorial projects**
* Produce layouts and designs for event and activation displays and special builds for sets and stages
* Produce **basic animation and motion graphics**, including simple video editing for social media.
* Sketch and illustrate custom artwork assets as needed
* Collaborate closely with the creative team to bring concepts to life
* Ensure all work aligns with PALETTERA’s high standards of quality and creativity
* Conduct occasional in\-studio or off\-site photography for project assets
* Perform photo editing and colour correction on images and photographs
* Create physical samples and prototypes (paper mock\-ups, stationery samples, 3D printing models)
* Prepare and export files to print\-ready and production\-ready formats according to vendor specifications

**Assets** 

* Previous experience working with CAD software or renderings (Interior or Graphic Design)
* Prior involvement in event\-related projects or the events industry
* Background in video animation or motion\-based visual content
* Hands\-on experience with photography and/or videography
* Professional experience in editorial layout and publication design
* Proficiency in Chinese

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
* 3–5 years of relevant professional experience
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, After Effects)
* Demonstrated experience in editorial design and layout
* Solid understanding of preparing files for print, production, and digital publishing
* Basic animation and motion graphics capability
* Illustration skills
* Strong attention to detail and aesthetic judgment
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment
* High proficiency in English (required)

PALETTERA is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those shortlisted for the next stage will be contacted.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $22\.00\-$26\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* On\-site parking
* Vision care

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Markham, ON L3R 0N3: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Application question(s):

* Are you legally able to work in Canada?

Work Location: In person
